run_f_gold: run f_gold(n) to compute the sum of all binomial coefficients for n using 1 left-shifted by n
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled by running the main block with parameter sets and comparing results
create_f_filled: create f_filled(n) to implement the sum of binomial coefficients matching f_gold behavior
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the bitwise shift with an explicit binomial coefficient summation loop
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which returns 2 to the power of n as the sum of binomial coefficients
